careers.lead: We hire pipelayers, operators, finishers, form setters, drivers, and foremen who take pride in the work. Steady DFW-area projects, self-performed scopes, and a crew that has your back.

jobs.title: Pipelayer
jobs.description: Water, sewer & storm drain installation — grade, bed, lay, and joint pipe on underground utility crews.

jobs.title: Equipment Operator
jobs.description: Excavators, loaders, dozers, motor graders & skid steers on paving, grading, and utility work.

jobs.title: Concrete Finisher
jobs.description: Paving, curb & gutter, sidewalks, and structural flatwork — finish quality is our name on the street.

jobs.title: Form Setter
jobs.description: Set line and grade for paving, curbs, and structures — read plans, pull string, hold tolerance.

jobs.title: CDL Driver
jobs.description: Class A/B — haul equipment, aggregates, and materials between our yard, plants, and jobsites.

jobs.title: Concrete / Paving Foreman
jobs.description: Run a self-performed paving or flatwork crew — production, layout, quality, and safety.

jobs.title: Utility Crew Foreman
jobs.description: Lead underground crews on water, sewer & storm scopes — trench safety, testing, and schedule.

jobs.title: General Laborer
jobs.description: No experience required — show up, work hard, and learn a trade. We promote from within.
